parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto'); const out=[]; const state=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); state.eventIds=state.eventIds||[]; for(const item of items){const headers=item.json.headers||{}; const body=item.json.body||item.json; const ts=String(headers['x-paper-signature-timestamp']||''); const sig=String(headers['x-paper-signature-256']||''); if(!ts||Math.abs(Date.now()/1000-Number(ts))>300) throw new Error('stale signature'); const raw=JSON.stringify(body); const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',$env.PAPER_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET).update(ts+'.'+raw).digest('hex'); if(sig.length!==expected.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig),Buffer.from(expected))) throw new Error('bad signature'); if(state.eventIds.includes(body.id)) continue; state.eventIds.push(body.id); if(state.eventIds.length>10000) state.eventIds.splice(0,state.eventIds.length-10000); out.push({json:body});} return out;
